MIAMI, FL / ACCESS Newswire / November 27, 2026 / Sekur Private Data, Inc., a Miami-based Swiss-hosted cybersecurity, private communications, and defense communications company serving enterprise, government, and defense clients, and a wholly owned U.S. subsidiary of Sekur Private Data (OTCQB:SWISF)(CSE:SKUR)(FRA:GDT0) ("Sekur" or the "Company"), today announced that it has deployed a new user interface (UI) for SekurMessenger, its secure team messaging and collaboration platform, incorporating SekurVoice encrypted voice calling directly into the messaging experience. The new UI improves usability and the flow of functions across the application, making SekurMessenger much more user-friendly for the defense, government, enterprise, and executive users who rely on it every day. The Company has received great feedback on the new interface from users. The next phase of Sekur's product roadmap is completing the new SekurOne, planned for release by the third week of December 2026, before Christmas, with SekurVoice expected to launch as a separate plan and additional new solutions expected to be launched at the same time. These launches are part of Sekur's preparation for 2027, as the Company has started pre-sales efforts in the U.S. and internationally.

Bringing SekurVoice into SekurMessenger means users can move from a secure chat to a secure voice call within the same application, with a cleaner layout and a more logical flow between functions. The redesign is intended to make everyday tasks quicker and more intuitive, so that users spend less time navigating the application and more time communicating.

The new interface changes how SekurMessenger looks and works for the user, not how it protects them. End-to-end encryption, self-destructing messages, encrypted file transfers, Chat-by-Invite, and Sekur ID identity management with no phone number required all remain in place, built on Sekur's proprietary, Swiss-hosted architecture with zero reliance on Big Tech cloud infrastructure.

"Security only works if people actually use it, and that means the experience has to be as easy as the everyday apps people are used to," said Alain Ghiai, Founder and CEO of Sekur Private Data. "The new SekurMessenger interface, with SekurVoice built in, makes secure messaging and calling simpler and faster, and the feedback we have received from users has been great."

"This is the first step in a broader refresh of the Sekur platform. Our next phase is completing the new SekurOne, which we plan to release by the third week of December, before Christmas, and we expect to unveil more than just SekurOne at that time, including SekurVoice as its own plan. We are also already working on new interfaces for our admin panel, our registration process, and SekurMail, so that every part of the Sekur experience, from sign-up to daily use, meets the same standard."

Next Phase: SekurOne, SekurVoice, and Additional Solutions Planned Before Christmas

With the new SekurMessenger UI deployed, Sekur's development focus now turns to completing the new SekurOne, its fully encrypted voice/video, email, messaging, and VPN platform engineered on the proprietary HeliX data transfer architecture. The new SekurOne is planned for release by the third week of December 2026, before Christmas.

SekurOne will not be launched alone. SekurVoice is expected to launch as a separate plan before Christmas, giving clients the option to subscribe to Sekur's encrypted voice calling on its own, and Sekur expects to launch additional new solutions at the same time, with the unveiling planned before Christmas. Further details will be announced at launch. The timing and content of these releases are subject to the completion of development and testing, and there can be no assurance that they will be released on that schedule.

Preparing for 2027: Pre-Sales Underway in the U.S. and Internationally

The new interfaces and December launches are intended to prepare Sekur for 2027. The Company has started pre-sales efforts in the U.S. and internationally, including Africa, Latin America, the Middle East, and Central and Eastern Europe, and plans to enter 2027 with a refreshed, easier-to-use platform and an expanded set of solutions to offer enterprise, government, defense, and executive clients in those markets. Pre-sales efforts may not result in sales, and there can be no assurance as to the timing or amount of any resulting revenue.

New Interfaces Underway for Admin Panel, Registration, and SekurMail

Sekur is also developing a new UI for its admin panel, which organizations use to manage their users and accounts; a new UI for its registration process, to make it simpler for new users and organizations to sign up and get started; and a new UI for its SekurMail solutions, the Company's secure business and executive email platform.

Together with the new SekurMessenger UI and the upcoming SekurOne, these updates are intended to give Sekur's enterprise, government, defense, and executive clients a consistent, user-friendly experience across the entire platform, from onboarding and administration to daily secure communications.

Sekur Core Communications Solutions

Sekur delivers secure communications that work within and beyond the Sekur network, operating independently of conventional telecom infrastructure to reduce exposure to interception, SIGINT collection, traffic analysis, metadata exploitation, and hostile surveillance in contested environments. No Sekur solution data-mines or location-tracks its users.

All solutions are built on proprietary architecture with zero reliance on Big Tech cloud infrastructure, meeting the privacy, security, and OPSEC requirements of intelligence agencies, defense and federal organizations, military commands, diplomatic missions, government agencies, executives, and professionals handling CUI and other sensitive, mission-critical information. Deployments are supported by on-premises infrastructure options for full data sovereignty, mission assurance, and sole control over keys and data.

SekurOne - Encrypted Voice/Video, Email, Messaging, and VPN

A fully encrypted communications platform engineered on proprietary HeliX data transfer architecture, purpose-built to defeat telecom network tracing, resist Pegasus-style malware intrusion, and support CUI handling requirements. SekurOne is designed for defense and federal officials, military commanders, government leaders, and executives conducting confidential, operational, or sensitive conversations where standard carrier-based voice and video platforms present unacceptable interception and exploitation risk.

Call-by-Invite capability via SMS or SekurSend email ensures controlled access and eliminates unsolicited contact. Each user is assigned a unique Sekur ID for identity management, with no phone number required - preserving user privacy across all voice and video communications.

SekurMail - Secure Business and Executive Email

An enterprise- and government-grade encrypted email platform designed for defense and federal agencies, military commands, senior government officials, C-suite executives, and organizations handling confidential and operationally sensitive communications, including CUI correspondence. Built on proprietary architecture with zero dependence on Big Tech cloud infrastructure and no metadata tracking, SekurMail keeps sensitive communications private between sender and recipient.

Key capabilities include SekurSend/SekurReply for secure delivery to non-Sekur recipients without exposing sender identity or message content; full message delivery control and audit capability; encrypted file transfer; custom domain support for organizational integration; and active protection against phishing, social engineering, and Business Email Compromise (BEC) attacks targeting corporate and administrative networks.

SekurMessenger - Secure Team Messaging and Collaboration

A secure messaging platform providing end-to-end encrypted text, file transfer, voice messages, and collaboration capabilities for defense, military, government, and executive teams coordinating operational and mission-sensitive information, including CUI material. Features include self-destructing messages, encrypted file transfers, and compliance-grade archiving for recordkeeping and audit requirements.

Cross-network secure communications with non-Sekur users are supported via Chat-by-Invite, enabling secure coordination with coalition partners, external agencies, and field elements without compromising the network. Each user is assigned a unique Sekur ID for identity verification and contact authentication, with no phone number required.

SekurVPN - Enterprise Network Security and Identity Protection

An enterprise-grade Virtual Private Network leveraging proprietary HeliX encryption technology, engineered to provide secure internet access, identity obfuscation, and traffic protection for defense organizations, military and federal personnel, government agencies, and executives operating across remote, traveling, deployed, forward, or untrusted network environments.

SekurVPN maintains zero data logging, ensuring no record of user activity exists that could be exposed through legal process, network compromise, or third-party collection. It is built for defense, government, and executive use cases - including protection of traffic associated with CUI and operationally sensitive workflows - where standard commercial VPN solutions present unacceptable privacy and security risk.

SekurRelay - Executive-Level Secure Email Integration

An enterprise-grade secure email relay solution enabling domain splitting, which allows organizations to establish secure communications at the executive, board, or senior staff level without requiring full organizational migration or infrastructure overhaul.

SekurRelay removes one of the most significant barriers to large-scale defense, government, and enterprise deployment, enabling phased adoption that protects command leadership, flag officers, and the highest-value personnel and communications immediately while broader organizational rollout proceeds. It is designed for defense and government organizations, regulated industries, and enterprises requiring rapid, low-friction elevation of communications security at the command and executive tier, including environments handling CUI communications.

About Sekur Private Data
Sekur Private Data is a Swiss-hosted cybersecurity, defense communications, and privacy solutions provider, offering a secure suite of tools to protect governments, defense and federal agencies, businesses, and individuals from unauthorized access and cyber threats. With capabilities such as SekurOne, SekurMail, SekurMessenger, and SekurVPN, Sekur provides a reliable and secure means of digital communication and data storage for Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI), classified-adjacent and civilian communications use, grounded in Swiss privacy standards with on-premises infrastructure for government agencies, allowing for data sovereignty. Sekur sells its solutions through its website www.sekur.com, approved distributors and telecommunications companies globally, and through the U.S. General Services Administration (GSA) Multiple Award Schedule (MAS), Contract No. 47QTCA18D0089 serving governments, defense institutions, federal agencies, businesses, and consumers worldwide. Sekur's main sales operations are in Miami, USA.

Millicom (Tigo) Announces Voluntary Redemption in Full of its SEK 2.25 Billion Sustainability Notes due 2027

Luxembourg, November 27, 2026 – Millicom International Cellular S.A. (“Millicom”) today notified holders of its SEK 2,250,000,000 Senior Unsecured Floating Rate Sustainability Notes due 2027, bearing interest at STIBOR plus 3.00% (ISIN SE0017133754) (the "Notes") of the early voluntary redemption of the Notes in full. The Notes will be redeemed on December 23, 2026 (the "Redemption Date") at a redemption price equal to 100 per cent. of the nominal amount, together with accrued but unpaid interest. The redemption price will be paid on the Redemption Date to holders of record as of December 16, 2026. In conjunction with the redemption, the Notes will be delisted from the sustainable bond list of Nasdaq Stockholm.

SEATTLE, Nov. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Jones Soda Co. (CSE: JSDA) (OTCQB: JSDA) ("Jones Soda" or the "Company") announces that it has applied to voluntarily delist its common shares from the Canadian Securities Exchange ("CSE").

The proposed delisting is subject to CSE approval, and the Company will announce the effective date of the delisting once confirmed by the CSE. The Company's common shares are expected to continue to be quoted on the OTCQB Venture Market under the symbol "JSDA."

The Company's Board of Directors unanimously approved the voluntary delisting on October 27, 2026, following an assessment of the relative benefits and costs of maintaining its presence on both the CSE and OTCQB.

Given the limited trading volume of the Company's common shares on the CSE relative to the OTCQB, the Company has determined that the costs and administrative requirements associated with maintaining both trading venues outweigh the benefits.

The voluntary delisting is expected to reduce exchange, exchange related-compliance and administrative costs while maintaining access to the Company's existing U.S. trading market.

The Company continues to actively pursue an uplisting of its common shares to a major U.S. national securities exchange as part of its broader capital markets strategy. Any such uplisting remains subject to satisfying applicable listing requirements and obtaining the necessary regulatory and exchange approvals. There can be no assurance that a listing will be completed or as to its timing.

The delisting itself will not affect shareholders' ownership of the Company's common shares or the rights associated with those shares. Shareholders are encouraged to contact their brokers regarding their ability to trade the Company's common shares on the OTCQB following the delisting. The removal of the CSE trading venue may affect trading access and liquidity for certain shareholders.

Shareholders requiring additional information or assistance may also contact the Company's investor relations representative using the contact information provided below.

About Jones Soda Co.

Jones Soda Co. is a leading craft beverage company known for its bold flavors, distinctive packaging and consumer-driven brand engagement. The Company markets and distributes its products across North America through traditional retail channels, e-commerce and strategic partnerships. The Company is headquartered in Seattle, Washington.

For more information, please visit www.jonessoda.com.

As previously announced, CAE solicited written consents and proxies (the "Consent and Proxy Solicitation") from the holders (the "Noteholders") of CAE's outstanding Notes issued under the master trust indenture, dated as of June 12, 2023 (the "Master Indenture"), as supplemented by a first supplemental indenture dated as of June 12, 2023 (together with the Master Indenture, the "Indenture"), between CAE, as issuer, and Computershare Advantage Trust of Canada (as successor to BNY Trust Company of Canada), as trustee (the "Trustee"), to approve an amendment to the definitions relating to the accounting principles referenced in the Master Indenture (the "Proposed Amendment") by way of Extraordinary Resolution (as defined in the Indenture) (the "Amendment Resolution"), the full text of which is set forth in the joint consent and proxy solicitation statement (as it may be amended or supplemented, the "Consent and Proxy Solicitation Statement"), and to authorize CAE and the Trustee to enter into a second supplemental indenture to the Indenture (the "2nd Supplemental Indenture") pursuant to which the Proposed Amendment will come into force, all subject to the terms and conditions set forth in the Consent and Proxy Solicitation Statement.

Net income as a percentage of revenue improved to 13.4% from 13.0% in Q1 2026. Selling, general and administrative expenses increased by only 4.4% to $499,995 despite the 34.9% increase in revenues.

The Company ended the quarter with cash and cash equivalents of $5,844,750, an increase of $380,045 (7.0%) since June 30, 2026, and during the quarter added $505,362 (7.8%) to working capital and $476,678 (6.6%) to shareholders' equity. Provides Drilling Update on its Flagship Elida Porphyry Cu-Mo-Ag Deposit

Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - November 27, 2026) - Element 29 Resources Inc. (TSXV: ECU) (OTCQX: EMTRF) (BVL: ECU) ("Element 29" or the "Company") is pleased to announce that it has signed a three-year surface Access Agreement with the host community at its Flor de Cobre Porphyry Copper-Molybdenum ("Cu-Mo") Project ("Flor de Cobre" or the "Project") in southern Perú (Figure 1). This agreement, which expires November 5, 2029, secures long-term access to Flor de Cobre and marks a significant milestone for the Company.

Richard Osmond, President and CEO, commented: "The successful signing of the community Access Agreement underscores the strength of our local relationships and commitment to advancing our projects in close collaboration with rightsholders. We remain focused on progressing Flor de Cobre in a responsible and mutually beneficial manner as we work to unlock its full exploration potential. We are grateful to the community for their ongoing support and partnership."

The signing of the Access Agreement with the host Indigenous community at Flor de Cobre satisfies the final outstanding community-access requirement associated with the Company's application for a Permiso de Inicio de Actividades ("PIA") drilling permit. The PIA application seeks authorization to commence exploration drilling covered by the already approved Declaración de Impacto Ambiental ("DIA") environmental certificate, which provides for drilling from up to 40 platforms over a five-year period (see the March 1, 2024 news release).

The Company previously received an exemption from the Consulta Previa ("Prior Consultation") process on October 21, 2024 (see October 31, 2024 news release), following a review by the Peruvian Ministry of Energy and Mines ("MINEM") of the Collective Impacts Report and its assessment of the potential impacts of exploration drilling on the host Indigenous community's lands.

The Company submitted the PIA application to MINEM on November 10, 2026, which remains pending review and final approval.

Elida Drilling Program Update

The ongoing Elida drilling program is being conducted under the 40-platform PIA drill permit approved in July of 2026 (see the July 28, 2026, news release). The Company started the year with two diamond drill rigs, then added a third rig in September and a fourth is scheduled to arrive in early December. The Company has completed 9,292 metres of its planned 10,000-metre 2026 program. Cumulative drilling at Elida now totals 32,699 metres, more than twice the 14,361 metres of drilling used to prepare the 2022 initial pit-constrained Inferred Mineral Resource Estimate ("MRE") ¹.

Elida is accessible year-round for drilling, and the Company plans to continue the program with four rigs for the remainder of 2026 and through 2027. Local assay laboratory turnaround is currently two to four weeks.

Assay Results Pending for Recently Completed Holes

Recently completed holes ELID044 and ELID045 reached depths of 1,812.8 metres and 1,820.6 metres, respectively. Both holes focused on step-out drilling to extend Zone 1 westward and evaluate potential resource expansion beyond the current MRE. They were designed to follow up on the long-mineralized intercepts in ELID033, ELID035 and ELID037, which suggest the potential for stronger Cu-Mo-Ag mineralization at depth and westward toward the contact with the Coastal Batholith (Figure 2).

ELID044 intersected 1,572.9 metres of potassic-altered volcanosedimentary rocks, from 35.1 metres below the bedrock surface to 1,608.0 metres downhole. The interval contains porphyry-related stockwork veining of varying intensity, with disseminated and stringer chalcopyrite-molybdenite mineralization. At 1,608.0 metres, the hole entered a potassic-altered granodiorite intrusion with stockwork veining and disseminated and stringer chalcopyrite-molybdenite mineralization. The granodiorite continued to the end of the hole at 1,812.8 metres, where drilling was shut down due to the depth limitations of the rig.

ELID045 intersected potassic-altered volcanosedimentary rocks, from 78.7 metres below the bedrock surface to 1,245.5 metres downhole. The interval contains stockwork veining, with disseminated and stringer chalcopyrite-molybdenite mineralization. At 1,245.5 metres, the hole intersected 61.2 metres of potassic-altered granodiorite cut by narrow fingers of potassic-altered quartz monzonite porphyry ("QMP"). Both rock types contain stockwork veining with disseminated chalcopyrite-molybdenite mineralization. From 1,306.7 metres, the hole intersected 358.9 metres of potassic-altered QMP, interpreted as an early-intermineral porphyry, with stockwork veining and disseminated and stringer chalcopyrite-molybdenite mineralization. Below this interval, the hole re-entered potassic-altered, locally brecciated volcanosedimentary rocks, with stockwork veining and disseminated and stringer chalcopyrite-molybdenite mineralization. The hole terminated at 1,820.6 metres due to the depth limitations of the rig.

ELID046 was drilled to a depth of 956.2 metres and was the first hole to evaluate Zone 4, a high-priority target immediately west of Zone 1 within the Elida porphyry cluster. Zone 4 hosts a mineralized porphyry stock emplaced along the contact between the Coastal Batholith and volcanosedimentary rocks. The stock and host rocks exhibit phyllic alteration overprinting earlier potassic alteration, as well as visible copper-oxide staining and anomalous Cu-Mo rock geochemistry. These features support the target's prospectivity for Cu-Mo-Ag mineralization. The hole intersected a 395.9-metre interval of phyllic-overprinted, potassic-altered QMP beginning at 197.8 metres downhole. The QMP is interpreted as a potassic-altered intermineral porphyry intrusion, with stockwork veining containing disseminated and stringer chalcopyrite-molybdenite mineralization. Locally, chalcocite and covellite occur as disseminations and rimming chalcopyrite and pyrite.

True widths are unknown, and assay results for all three holes are pending.

Metallurgical Test Work

In parallel, the Company is advancing the resource modelling and metallurgical test work with Synectiq Inc., as announced on May 7, 2026. The test work is designed to characterize the principal ore types, evaluate copper, molybdenum, and silver recoveries, and assess concentrate quality. The results are intended to support assumptions for an updated mineral resource estimate and future technical studies.

About Flor de Cobre

Flor de Cobre is located 35 kilometres southeast of Arequipa and straddles the border between the Departments of Arequipa and Moquegua, the Provinces of Arequipa and General Sanchez Cerro, and the Districts of Polobaya and La Capilla.

The property is comprised of eleven mining concessions for a total of 2,984.4 hectares ("ha") which are 100% owned by the Company's Peruvian subsidiary Candelaria Resources S.A.C. The project is in the Southern Perú Copper Belt, which is host to numerous porphyry Cu-Mo deposits, including the Cerro Verde Cu-Mo mine operated by Freeport-McMoRan2; the Cuajone and Toquepala Cu-Mo mines operated by Southern Copper2; and the Quellaveco Cu-Mo mine operated by Anglo American2. Flor de Cobre is 5 kilometres northwest of the Chapi Mine and 26 kilometres southeast of the Cerro Verde Mine (Figure 1).

Flor de Cobre hosts the Atravesado porphyry Cu-Mo target, a classic Andean porphyry system with Cu-Mo mineralization potentially associated with a multi-phase quartz monzonite porphyry complex. Atravesado is characterized by widespread Cu-oxide mineralization and strong surface rock Cu geochemistry associated with lower Cretaceous-aged quartzite and sandstone sedimentary rocks which form the upper part of the Yura Group. These rocks are also cut by several narrow potassic altered quartz monzonite porphyry dykes.

The property is situated at a modest elevation of 2,700 metres with excellent infrastructure for future mine development and is accessible along paved and maintained unpaved roads from the hub-city of Arequipa.

NESS ZIONA, Israel, Nov. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Foresight Autonomous Holdings Ltd. (Nasdaq and TASE: FRSX) (“Foresight” or the “Company”), an innovator in 3D perception systems and AI autonomous stacks, today announced that its wholly owned subsidiary, Foresight Intelligent Systems Ltd., has received a conditional and non-binding order from an Indian drone manufacturing company for thermal ScaleCam 3D perception systems. The order is valued at approximately $1.3 million and the systems are intended for integration into autonomous drones for the Indian defense forces.

The order is part of the commercial cooperation framework announced by the Company in January 2025 with a prominent Indian drone manufacturer that is a supplier of the Indian Ministry of Defense. That framework carried previously disclosed commercial potential of up to $2.1 million. The current order follows the successful completion of the validation of Foresight’s thermal ScaleCam 3D perception solution under the agreement.

The order is conditional and remains subject to certain conditions including the successful completion of trials with the Indian Navy, completion of the relevant procurement and commercial negotiation process, and receipt of all required governmental, export-control, and regulatory approvals, where applicable.

Foresight’s 3D perception solution, which uses stereoscopic long-wave infrared technology and integrates internal measurement unit sensors, is designed to maintain robust autonomous drone performances in challenging GPS-denied environments such as dense smoke, poor lighting and high temperatures, enabling the detection of fire source and all object detection while providing real-time information on the drone’s spatial positioning. These capabilities make the solution particularly well-suited for defense unmanned ariel vehicle applications.

“The receipt of this conditional order is an important step forward in our collaboration with our Indian partner and validates the successful completion of the development phase,” said Haim Siboni, Chief Executive Officer of Foresight Intelligent Systems Ltd. “We look forward to progressing through the remaining trials and procurement stages.”

Foresight Autonomous Holdings Ltd. (Nasdaq and TASE: FRSX) is a technology company developing advanced three-dimensional (3D) perception systems, AI autonomous stack, and cellular-based applications. Through its wholly owned subsidiaries, Foresight Intelligent Systems Ltd. (formerly known as Foresight Automotive Ltd.), Foresight Changzhou Automotive Ltd., and Eye-Net Mobile Ltd., Foresight develops both “in-line-of-sight” vision systems and “beyond-line-of-sight” accident-prevention solutions.

Foresight’s 3D perception systems include modules of automatic calibration and dense 3D point cloud that can be applied to different markets such as automotive, defense, autonomous driving, agriculture, heavy industrial equipment, and unmanned aerial vehicles.

Eye-Net Mobile develops next-generation vehicle-to-everything collision prevention solutions and smart automotive systems to enhance road safety and situational awareness for all road users in urban mobility environments. By leveraging cutting-edge artificial intelligence technology, advanced analytics, and existing cellular networks, Eye-Net’s innovative solution suite delivers real-time pre-collision alerts to all road users via smartphones and other smart devices within vehicles.

VANCOUVER, British Columbia, Nov. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Entrée Resources Ltd. (TSX:ETG; OTCQB:ERLFF – the “Company” or “Entrée”) is pleased to provide an update on its recent engagement with the Government Working Group in Mongolia. Additionally, the Company is pleased to provide analytical results received from the Company’s joint venture partner Oyu Tolgoi LLC (“OT LLC”) for an additional seven underground infill diamond drill holes (“DDH”) at the Hugo North Extension (“HNE”) deposit on the Entrée/Oyu Tolgoi joint venture property (the “Entrée/Oyu Tolgoi JV Property”) in Mongolia. The drill holes were completed by OT LLC between 2023 and 2026 (see Table 1 below).  

ENGAGEMENT WITH GOVERNMENT WORKING GROUP
On November 9 and 10, 2026, the Company met with members of the Government Working Group in Mongolia to commence negotiations for the purpose of resolving outstanding matters in relation to the Shivee Tolgoi and Javkhlant mining licenses (the “Licenses”). The newly reconstituted Government Working Group was established on October 2, 2026 pursuant to Order No.217 of the Prime Minister of Mongolia and is led by the Minister of Justice and Internal Affairs. At the meeting, the parties agreed a framework for negotiations comprising four key points:

  • The parties shall make reasonable efforts to resolve the outstanding matters in accordance with the Constitution of Mongolia, applicable laws, and the applicable legal framework within the first quarter 2027. Should the parties be unable to reach an agreement within such period, the parties may mutually agree on an extension of the negotiation period.
  • The parties expressly acknowledge that, pursuant to Article 8.1.7 of the Minerals Law of Mongolia, the Parliament of Mongolia has the authority to determine the State’s shareholding percentage in the private legal entity holding the Shivee Tolgoi and Javkhlant mining licenses of strategic importance, and to decide whether such shareholding is to be replaced by a special royalty for the use of mineral resources of a mineral deposit, noting that nothing herein prejudges the form, scope or structure of any such arrangement, which remains subject to negotiation and all necessary approvals and consents.
  • Any transfer of the Licenses shall be undertaken in accordance with applicable law and all required approvals.
  • The parties shall make reasonable efforts to ensure that the composition of their authorized working group remains unchanged for the duration of the negotiations.

The Company’s next step is to prepare, in consultation with other stakeholders, a revised proposal for consideration by the Government Working Group. The Company’s principal corporate objectives continue to be resolution of State participation in the area of the Licenses and transfer of the Licenses to OT LLC in accordance with applicable laws and the Company’s contracts. The Company remains committed to working towards a constructive solution that serves the interests of all Oyu Tolgoi project stakeholders and enables OT LLC to resume Lift 1 underground development and extraction activities on the Shivee Tolgoi license area.

DRILL HOLE HIGHLIGHTS

  • UGD918: 65.73 metres grading 1.02% copper equivalent (“CuEq”).
  • UGD918A: 67.6 metres grading 1.07% CuEq.
  • UGD1025A: 125.31 metres grading 1.45% CuEq.

HNE DRILLING RESULTS

DDH UGD918 (and daughter hole UGD918A) was collared on the Oyu Tolgoi mining licence and drilled at a moderate dip towards the northeast.  After crossing onto the Entrée/Oyu Tolgoi JV Property it immediately entered the central portion of the HNE deposit and was drilled parallel to the main mineralized trend in moderately phyllic altered, quartz monzodiorite, cut by occasional basalt andesite dikes.  The quartz monzodiorite is mineralized with 3-5% sulphides with mostly chalcopyrite and lesser bornite, along with minor pyrite and returned moderate to high grades of copper and gold as shown in Table 1.  The DDH terminated in strong mineralization. 

DDH UGD1012A was collared on the Oyu Tolgoi mining licence and drilled at a moderate dip towards the northeast. Underground DDH UGD1016 was collared on the Oyu Tolgoi mining licence and drilled at a moderate dip towards the north. Once crossing onto the Entrée/Oyu Tolgoi JV Property the DDH entered 60 meters of unmineralized footwall biotite granodiorite to the west of the main HNE deposit. No significant grades of copper or gold were returned from this drill hole.

Underground DDH UGD1025A was drilled from the Oyu Tolgoi mining licence to the northwest at a moderate to steep dip.  After crossing onto the Entrée/Oyu Tolgoi JV Property the DDH entered into phyllic altered quartz monzodiorite, with minor intervals of biotite granodiorite and basalt andesite dikes, which changed to potassic alteration further down the hole.  Copper and gold grades remained strong until about 488 metres depth, beyond which the DDH crossed out of the western edge of the HNE deposit and grades were weakly anomalous until the end of the hole.

The final underground drill hole with analytical results is UGD1053, which was collared from an underground drill pad on the Oyu Tolgoi mining licence, east of the HNE deposit. The drill hole was drilled northeast at a moderate dip, remaining parallel to, and just east of the edge of the HNE deposit and was designed primarily for geotechnical purposes.  The drill hole crossed a mix of advanced argillic and phyllic altered porphyritic augite basalt and ignimbrite with several basalt andesite dikes. Copper grades remained low grade over most of the drill holes while gold grades were anomalous to low grade.

2026 HNE and Regional Drill Hole Information

Collars for the 2026 HNE underground drill holes were surveyed using a Leica TS16 instrument and downhole surveys were collected approximately every 30 metres using an IMDEX EZ-TrackTM driller operated, multi-shot survey instrument. Collars for the HNE surface and regional drill holes were surveyed using either an Emlid Reach RS3 or Trimble GPS R10 GPS system and downhole surveys were collected approximately every 30 metres using an EZ-TRAC digital instrument.  The 2026 HNE surface and regional drill holes were collared with PQ diameter core (123 mm) and often reduced to HQ (96 mm) core diameter at depth.  Underground holes at HNE were collared using HQ diameter and occasionally reduced to NQ (76 mm) at depth. 

Drill core from the 14 underground DDHs and two surface DDHs reported for HNE and for the three regional exploration DDHs and eight condemnation DDHs were geologically and geotechnically logged at site by OT LLC.  All core was saw-cut on site before being bagged and shipped to the laboratory.  Samples were either quarter core or half core depending on whether a portion was also used for metallurgical test work or other purposes.  Sample lengths generally averaged approximately 2.0 metres and core recovery was recorded as being very good (>95% recovery), except in localized areas of faulting/fracturing. 

Core from 2026 HNE drilling was shipped to ALS Laboratory (“ALS”) in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia, for sample preparation.  ALS is independent of OT LLC, Rio Tinto and Entrée. At ALS the samples were crushed to <2mm and pulverized to 75μm, then the pulps were shipped directly by ALS to their laboratory in Perth, Australia for analysis. HNE samples were predominantly analyzed for gold by ICP21 (30g fire assay with ICP-AES finish) and a multi-element package including copper, silver and molybdenum by MS61 (four-acid digestion of 0.25g sample paired with ICP-MS). Copper values greater than approximately 1.0% were further analyzed by OG62 (ore grade copper using a 0.4 g sample and a 4-acid digestion with an ICP finish).

Core from regional exploration drilling were shipped to ALS Laboratory in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia for sample preparation. At ALS, the samples were crushed to <2mm and pulverized to 75μm, then the pulps were shipped directly by ALS to their laboratory in Perth, Australia for analysis. Samples were predominantly analyzed for gold by ICP21 (30g fire assay with ICP-AES finish) and a 48-element package including copper, silver and molybdenum by MS61L (four-acid digestion of 0.25 g sample paired with ICP-MS).   

Core from condemnation drillholes were shipped to SGS Laboratory in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia for sample preparation and analysis. SGS is independent of OT LLC, Rio Tinto and Entrée.  At SGS the samples were crushed to <2mm and pulverized to 75μm.  Samples were predominantly analyzed for gold by fire assay (30g FA with AAS finish) and a multi-element package including copper, silver and molybdenum by IC40M (ICP-MS after four-acid digestion).

OT LLC follows a rigorous quality assurance/quality control (“QAQC”) program for the sampling programs that includes the regular insertion of standards, blanks and duplicates into the sample stream. The QP is not aware of any drilling, sampling, recovery, or other factors that could materially affect the accuracy or reliability of the data referred to in this disclosure.

Entrée Resources Ltd. is a Canadian mining company with a unique carried joint venture interest on a significant portion of one of the world’s largest copper-gold projects – the Oyu Tolgoi project in Mongolia.  Entrée has a 20% or 30% carried participating interest in the Entrée/Oyu Tolgoi JV, depending on the depth of mineralization. QUÉBEC, QC / ACCESS Newswire / November 27, 2026 / NuRAN Wireless Inc. (Nasdaq:NUR)(FSE:1RN) ("NuRAN" or the "Company") today announced that the Investment Committee of the AFRIGREEN Debt Impact Fund ("AFRIGREEN") has approved a long-term senior secured loan of up to €10 million (approximately US$10,97 million) to NuRAN Wireless Côte d'Ivoire SARL ("NuRAN CI"), the Company's Ivorian operating subsidiary. The loan will finance the solar and energy storage systems that power the rural mobile sites NuRAN is building for MTN Côte d'Ivoire ("MTN CI"). The approval follows AFRIGREEN's due diligence.

Highlights

  • Institutional validation of the NuRAN model. AFRIGREEN is a €100 million infrastructure debt fund managed by RGREEN INVEST and advised by ECHOSYS INVEST. Its Investment Committee approved the financing after reviewing the MTN CI contract, the Côte d'Ivoire market and the proposed structure.
  • Long-term money for long-term assets. The facility has a final maturity of June 30, 2033 and a 24-month grace period before principal repayments begin, so that sites can be built, accepted and producing revenue before the debt starts to amortize.
  • Debt arrives as revenue arrives. The loan is drawn in batches of at least €1 million, each one against sites that have been commissioned and accepted by MTN CI. Borrowing therefore grows in step with the base of sites that are in service and billing.
  • Financed at the project, not at the parent. The borrower is NuRAN CI, and the loan is secured by the Ivorian project's own assets, contract and receivables, together with a pledge of the shares of NuRAN CI. The approved terms include no warrants, conversion rights or other equity-linked features.
  • A model built to be repeated. NuRAN has more than 5,000 sites under contract across Africa. Management intends to use the Côte d'Ivoire structure, in which a specialist lender finances the energy infrastructure and equity finances the telecom equipment, as the template for financing its other markets.

"This is the catalyst we have been working toward," said Francis Létourneau, Chief Executive Officer of NuRAN. "Last week we fixed the capital structure. This week a specialist infrastructure lender has completed its diligence on our Côte d'Ivoire project and its Investment Committee has said yes. Our business turns capital into sites and sites into recurring revenue. With this approval, we now know exactly what the capital plan for Côte d'Ivoire looks like and what we need to deliver to unlock it. There is real work ahead of us, on documentation, with MTN CI and on the equity, and we are already on it."

"The structure is disciplined, and that is what we want," said Jim Bailey, Chief Financial Officer of NuRAN. "The debt sits in the Ivorian subsidiary, it is drawn only against sites that MTN CI has accepted, and it is repaid from the cash flow of those sites over a term that runs to 2033. The lender finances the solar and storage systems and our equity finances the telecom equipment. We believe that is the right way to finance long-lived infrastructure, and it is a structure we can take to our other markets."

What the Approval Means

NuRAN's growth has been limited by capital, not by demand. The Company holds contracts for more than 5,000 sites, including an agreement with MTN CI for the rollout of up to 1,000 rural sites in Côte d'Ivoire. Each site has to be financed and built before it earns revenue. Until now, that capital has come mainly from the parent company's balance sheet.

Project financing changes that equation. A lender that specializes in African energy infrastructure has reviewed a NuRAN country project and approved long-term debt against it. The debt is sized to the cash flow of the sites, drawn as sites enter service and repaid over a period that matches the life of the assets. The approval also tells investors what the Company must do next: complete the loan documentation, finalize arrangements with MTN CI and raise the equity that sits alongside the debt. Each of these steps can be tracked.

Next Steps

NuRAN and AFRIGREEN are targeting signing of the facility agreement in January 2027, with closing expected four to six weeks after signing. Before then, the Company will work with MTN CI on the assignment of the network-as-a-service agreement to NuRAN CI and on a direct agreement with the lender, negotiate the facility and security documents, agree with AFRIGREEN on the number of equity-funded sites to be in service before the first drawdown, and advance its equity financing plan. The Company will provide updates as these milestones are reached.

Transaction Summary

The loan will be available for 24 months and drawn in batches of at least €1 million. Each drawdown requires certification by the lender's technical adviser that the relevant sites have been commissioned and accepted by MTN CI, and the prior injection of the corresponding equity. Interest will accrue at EURIBOR plus 6.50%, fixed on the date of signing. After a 24-month grace period, the loan will be repaid on a schedule based on a debt service coverage ratio of 2.0 times, with final maturity on June 30, 2033.

The loan will be secured by a pledge of the shares of NuRAN CI, security over its equipment, bank accounts, insurances and warranties, and an assignment of the MTN CI agreement and its receivables, with MTN CI paying into a pledged collection account. Amounts payable by NuRAN CI to the Company will be subordinated to debt service and reserve funding. The facility will include covenants customary for a project financing, including an operating cost budget supported by an undertaking from the NuRAN group to fund overruns, reporting on the Company's liquidity, a change of control provision, and environmental and social undertakings.

Signing and the first drawdown are subject to further conditions. These include the assignment of the MTN CI agreement to NuRAN CI and MTN CI's acknowledgement of the lender's security and step-in rights; MTN CI's confirmation of the term of each site; a minimum number of equity-funded sites, still to be agreed, being commissioned and accepted before the first drawdown; a software licence and technology escrow in favour of NuRAN CI; equipment warranties; site leases, installation and operating arrangements satisfactory to the lender; environmental and social requirements; and satisfactory legal due diligence and know-your-client checks. A small number of identified sites are excluded from the financing until specific environmental or land matters are resolved.

About AFRIGREEN Debt Impact Fund:

The AFRIGREEN Debt Impact Fund is a €100 million senior debt fund that provides long-term financing for solar infrastructure in Central and West Africa. The fund is managed by RGREEN INVEST, a French investment manager specializing in the energy transition, and is advised by ECHOSYS INVEST. Its investors include European and international development finance institutions.

About NuRAN Wireless:

NuRAN Wireless Inc. (Nasdaq:NUR)(FSE:1RN) is a rural telecommunications infrastructure company connecting remote and underserved communities across Africa. Through its Network-as-a-Service model, NuRAN finances, builds, owns, operates and maintains 2G, 3G and 4G mobile network infrastructure for mobile network operators seeking to expand coverage outside urban markets.

NuRAN has more than 5,000 sites under contract, of which a portion has been built and is operating today. The Company combines telecommunications engineering, low-power wireless technology, renewable-energy-enabled infrastructure, site selection and field operations to address the economic and technical challenges of rural mobile coverage.

New Leadership Safeguards Significant Tax Assets to Shield Future Taxable Income and Support Plan to Return PetMeds to Sustainable Profitability and Drive Shareholder Value

Concurrently Terminates Prior Limited Duration Shareholder Rights Plan

DELRAY BEACH, Fla., Nov. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- PetMed Express, Inc., dba PetMeds and parent company of PetCareRx, (Nasdaq: PETS) (the “Company”), today announced that its Board of Directors has approved the adoption of a Tax Benefit Preservation Plan (or “the plan”) which is effective immediately. The plan is specifically tailored to protect and preserve PetMeds’ potentially valuable tax assets primarily associated with net operating loss carryforwards or NOLs that could be utilized in certain circumstances to offset PetMeds’ future taxable income and reduce its future federal income tax liability.

Concurrently, the Board approved the immediate termination of PetMeds’ prior limited duration shareholder rights plan, originally adopted on December 3, 2024, by accelerating its final expiration date from the close of business on December 2, 2026 to 12:01 a.m. Eastern Time on November 27, 2026. Accordingly, all Rights issued thereunder have expired, without any consideration or payment being made in respect thereof, and no person has any further rights, obligations, or liabilities thereunder, except for those provisions of that rights plan that by their express terms survive termination (including, without limitation, the indemnification, exculpation, and limitation of liability obligations of PetMeds to the Rights Agent).

New Leadership Mandate and Strategic Rationale for Protecting and Preserving NOLs

Following the appointment of Jeff Willard as PetMeds’ President and Chief Executive Officer, the new leadership of PetMeds reviewed its operations, capital structure, and asset base to optimize the use of all assets and establish a direct, clear path back to sustainable profitability and growth. As part of this asset-optimization strategy, management identified PetMeds’ accumulated NOLs as a balance sheet asset that needed to be protected and preserved.

Over the approximately two years since the adoption of the prior rights plan, PetMeds has incurred operating losses that generated significant federal NOL carryforwards. Relative to PetMeds’ current market capitalization, these tax attributes represent a material and potentially valuable corporate asset. Because an “ownership change” under Section 382 of the Internal Revenue Code (“Section 382”) could severely restrict or permanently eliminate PetMeds’ ability to utilize these tax attributes, the Board determined that adopting a Tax Benefit Preservation Plan directly supports leadership’s plans to optimize the use of all assets, return PetMeds to sustainable profitability and growth, and drive long-term shareholder value.

“Since taking the helm in September, my top priority has been conducting a comprehensive review of our strategy, execution, and balance sheet to identify every available lever to restore PetMeds to profitability, strengthen our financial position, and drive long-term shareholder value,” said Jeff Willard, President and Chief Executive Officer of PetMeds. “In a turnaround, speed matters. We are moving at a new pace, focused on repositioning the brand, upgrading our e-commerce experience, and taking costs out of the business. Our substantial net operating loss carryforwards represent a material asset that we hope to eventually monetize. As we work to return PetMeds to profitable growth, these tax assets can help shield future taxable income and drive long-term shareholder value. Adopting a Tax Benefit Preservation Plan helps protect these tax assets for the benefit of all PetMeds shareholders as our turnaround takes hold.”

Preservation of Net Operating Loss Carryforwards

As of November 2026, PetMeds had an estimate of approximately $43.4 million in federal NOL carryforwards available to offset future corporate income tax obligations. PetMeds’ ability to fully utilize these tax assets could be substantially limited if PetMeds undergoes an “ownership change” as defined under Section 382.

In general, an ownership change occurs under Section 382 if the aggregate percentage stock ownership of one or more “5-percent shareholders” (as defined for tax purposes) increases by more than 50 percentage points over a rolling three-year period over the lowest percentage of stock owned by such shareholders during that period.

In order to protect PetMeds’ NOLs from being limited or permanently lost under Section 382, the Tax Benefit Preservation Plan is intended to reduce the likelihood of an unintended “ownership change” occurring by deterring any person or group from acquiring beneficial ownership of 4.9% or more of PetMeds’ outstanding common stock without the approval of the Board. PetMeds’ Tax Benefit Preservation Plan does not, however, block anyone from buying or selling PetMeds’ common stock. Accordingly, there can be no assurance that the Tax Benefit Preservation Plan will prevent an “ownership change.” PetMeds’ Tax Benefit Preservation Plan is similar to those plans adopted by numerous other public companies with significant NOLs.

Key Terms of the Tax Benefit Preservation Plan

Under the terms of the Tax Benefit Preservation Plan, PetMeds will distribute to its shareholders one Series B preferred stock purchase right for each share of PetMeds’ common stock held as of the close of business on December 7, 2026. Any shares of common stock issued after the December 7, 2026 record date will be issued together with associated preferred stock purchase rights.

Under the Tax Benefit Preservation Plan, the rights will initially trade with PetMeds’ common stock. The rights will generally become exercisable only if a person (or any persons acting as a group) acquires beneficial ownership of 4.9% or more of PetMeds’ outstanding common stock, without the approval of the Board, after the first public announcement by PetMeds of the adoption of the Tax Benefit Preservation Plan. A person or group who acquires, without the approval of the Board, beneficial ownership of 4.9% or more of PetMeds’ outstanding common stock could be subject to significant dilution.

If the preferred stock purchase rights become exercisable, all holders of rights, other than the person or group triggering the rights, will be entitled to purchase PetMeds’ common stock at a 50% discount. The Board also has the option to cause the exchange of one share of common stock for each preferred stock purchase right held (other than the rights held by the person or group triggering the rights). Preferred stock purchase rights held by the person or group triggering the rights will become null and void and will not be exercisable, exchangeable, or transferable.

Shareholders who beneficially owned 4.9% or more of PetMeds’ outstanding common stock prior to the first public announcement by PetMeds of the adoption of the Tax Benefit Preservation Plan will not trigger any penalties under the Tax Benefit Preservation Plan so long as they do not acquire beneficial ownership of any additional shares of common stock (other than pursuant to a stock split, stock dividend, reclassification, or similar transaction effected by PetMeds) at a time when they still beneficially own 4.9% or more of such common stock. The Board also has the discretion to exempt any acquisition of PetMeds’ common stock from the provisions of the Tax Benefit Preservation Plan.

The preferred stock purchase rights and the Tax Benefit Preservation Plan will expire no later than November 25, 2029 unless the plan is extended. The preferred stock purchase rights and the Tax Benefit Preservation Plan may also expire on an earlier date upon the occurrence of other events, including a determination by the PetMeds Board that the Tax Benefit Preservation Plan is no longer necessary for the preservation of PetMeds’ tax attributes, PetMeds’ tax attributes are fully utilized or no longer available under applicable tax law, or the plan is no longer in the best interests of PetMeds and its shareholders. The preferred stock purchase rights may also be redeemed, exchanged, or terminated prior to their expiration.

PetMeds intends to submit the Tax Benefit Preservation Plan for ratification by PetMeds’ shareholders at its 2027 Annual Meeting of Shareholders. The date of PetMeds’ 2027 Annual Meeting of Shareholders has not yet been announced.

Additional Information

Additional information with respect to the termination of the prior rights plan and the adoption of the Tax Benefit Preservation Plan will be contained in the related Current Reports on Form 8-K and Registration Statements on Form 8-A that PetMeds will file with the Securities and Exchange Commission. Copies of these documents can be obtained free of charge, when available, at the SEC’s website, www.sec.gov, and at PetMeds’ website, www.PetMeds.com.

About PetMed Express, Inc.

Founded in 1996, PetMeds is a pioneer in the direct-to-consumer pet healthcare sector. As a trusted national online pharmacy, PetMeds is licensed across all 50 states and staffed with expert pharmacists dedicated to supporting pet wellness, pets and pet parents, and the veterinarians who serve them. Through its PetMeds family of brands and through its PetCareRx subsidiary, the Company offers a comprehensive range of pet health solutions - including top-brand and generic pharmaceuticals, compounded medications, and better-for-your-pet OTC supplements and nutrition. Focused on value, convenience, and care, PetMeds and PetCareRx empower pet parents to help their dogs, cats, and horses live longer, healthier lives. NEW YORK CITY, NY / ACCESS Newswire / November 27, 2026 / America's industrial strength has long been fueled by a willingness to challenge conventional thinking, embrace emerging technologies and transform scientific breakthroughs into practical commercial solutions. From advances in manufacturing to the digital revolution, that entrepreneurial mindset has helped shape the nation's economic identity.

Now, SMX (Security Matters) PLC (NASDAQ:SMX)(NASDAQ:SMXWW) is bringing that same spirit to artificial intelligence, developing a specialized scientific platform designed to help industries address complex material challenges while opening new possibilities for technological innovation.

Known as SMX Scientific Intelligence (SMX SCI), the platform takes a distinct approach to AI. Instead of concentrating on general-purpose applications, it is being developed to address the scientific and technical requirements of industrial material development, chemical compatibility, manufacturing and material verification.

The initiative embraces a principle central to American innovation: technology delivers its greatest value when it moves beyond theory and provides solutions to real-world problems.

AI Designed for Real-World Industry

Much of the excitement surrounding artificial intelligence has centered on its ability to generate content, analyze information and automate everyday tasks. SMX SCI is being developed with a more focused mission: helping scientific and industrial teams identify, assess and optimize materials used in manufacturing.

The platform is intended to create a comprehensive scientific codex of chemical agents, additives, molecular markers and supplementary materials.

By integrating AI-driven analysis with SMX's existing scientific expertise, it aims to assess chemical properties, production requirements, manufacturing conditions and potential industrial uses.

The goal is to streamline early-stage material research, ease laboratory workloads and allow technical teams to direct testing resources toward the most promising candidates.

For manufacturers, these capabilities could translate into quicker evaluations of material suitability, more efficient product development and faster responses to technical challenges.

SMX SCI is also being designed to provide preliminary regulatory and material compatibility assessments, including requirements applicable in the United States and other major international markets.

Final determinations involving material suitability and regulatory compliance will still require appropriate testing, validation and review.

Continuing America's Tradition of Turning Ideas Into Industry

American entrepreneurship has consistently demonstrated the value of transforming scientific discoveries into commercial opportunities.

SMX's proposed platform builds on that tradition by integrating artificial intelligence with established industrial technologies rather than positioning AI as a standalone product.

The company's molecular marking technology is designed to provide physical materials with persistent identification, while its Digital Material Passport infrastructure links those materials to records of their composition, quality, origin and lifecycle history.

SMX SCI would introduce an additional layer of scientific intelligence, helping determine suitable marking agents, additives and material solutions for specific industrial applications.

Working together, these technologies are intended to connect scientific research with manufacturing, distribution, recovery and recycling operations.

The broader infrastructure has potential uses across plastics, packaging, precious metals, electronics, semiconductors and other sectors essential to modern industrial supply chains.

This combination of scientific expertise, advanced technology and practical industrial applications reflects the resourcefulness that has historically distinguished American innovation.

Transforming Innovation Into Commercial Opportunity

The entrepreneurial potential of SMX SCI reaches beyond its scientific applications.

SMX anticipates introducing the platform into its internal operations during the first quarter of 2027, with full operations expected in the second quarter, contingent on successful development and testing.

The company also intends to launch a limited commercial edition during the second quarter of 2027, offering selected capabilities to customers around the world.

The proposed service would assist with material identification, additive selection, product enhancement and preliminary regulatory and compatibility evaluations.

Developed by SMX's internal team alongside specialized subcontractors, the platform brings together expertise in artificial intelligence, large language models, conversational AI and scientific data analysis.

The planned offering could create an additional commercial opportunity for SMX, expanding its activities beyond material identification and digital verification into AI-powered scientific services.

Creating the Infrastructure for Tomorrow's Materials

SMX SCI is also expected to advance the company's broader initiative to establish trusted global standards for certified and graded recycled plastics.

Through the integration of scientific intelligence, molecular marking and Digital Material Passports, SMX seeks to improve material identification, verification and lifecycle traceability.

The platform could also support AI-enabled functions connected to SMX's planned Plastic Circularity Credits, including credit eligibility evaluations, price discovery and connections between buyers and suppliers of certified recycled materials.

These standards and commercial mechanisms are still being developed.

For American industry, the larger opportunity lies in applying purpose-built artificial intelligence to some of manufacturing's most persistent challenges, from material efficiency and product development to supply chain transparency.

SMX SCI remains under development, and its eventual capabilities and commercial success will depend on testing, validation and market adoption.

Yet the vision behind the platform embodies a distinctly American philosophy: innovation is not measured simply by the technologies we invent, but by how effectively we put those inventions to work.

SMX (Security Matters) PLC (NASDAQ:SMX) develops molecular traceability and material authentication technologies designed to strengthen supply-chain transparency and integrity across global industries. Its platform embeds invisible molecular markers directly into physical materials, including solids, liquids and gases, allowing them to carry a persistent identity that can be detected and verified throughout their lifecycle.

schedule 14cregulatory
Schedule 14C is an SEC filing that companies use to send an official information statement to shareholders when they are not asking for proxy votes. It lays out key facts about corporate actions—such as reorganizations, related-party transactions, or changes in governance—so investors can understand what’s happening without being asked to vote, like receiving a detailed neighborhood notice about a rule change rather than a petition. Because it provides formal, regulated disclosure, Schedule 14C helps investors verify claims, weigh potential impacts on ownership or value, and hold management accountable.
lock-up periodfinancial
A lock-up period is a fixed time after a stock offering during which company insiders and early investors are legally barred from selling their shares. It matters because when that restriction expires a large block of previously locked-up shares can enter the market at once, potentially lowering the stock price or spiking trading volume—like opening a floodgate—so investors monitor these dates to anticipate price moves and manage risk.

LEIFRAS Becomes OLC's First Equity-Method Affiliate Through OLI's Investment Activities

— OLI's ownership increases from approximately 0.8% at the time of its initial investment to approximately 20%, further strengthening the partnership built on nearly three years of collaboration —

TOKYO, Nov. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- LEIFRAS Co., Ltd. (headquartered in Shibuya-ku, Tokyo; Representative Director and Chief Executive Officer: Kiyotaka Ito; the "Company") today announced that, on November 27, 2026, it completed the third-party allotment of treasury shares to Oriental Land Innovations Co., Ltd. ("OLI"), a wholly owned corporate venture capital subsidiary of Oriental Land Co., Ltd. ("OLC" and together with its subsidiaries, the "Oriental Land Group"), as previously announced on November 5, 2026. Additionally, a transfer of certain shares held by the Company's Representative Director and Chief Executive Officer, Kiyotaka Ito, to OLI was completed on the same date.

As a result of these transactions, OLI's ownership interest in the Company increased from approximately 0.8% at the time of its initial investment in 2023 to approximately 20%. Accordingly, the Company will become an equity-method affiliate of OLC.

2. Significance of the Additional Investment and First Equity-Method Affiliate Through OLI's Investment Activities

OLI has engaged in investment activities since June 2020 with the aim of creating growth opportunities in new business areas for OLC. This transaction marks the first time that a company in which OLI has invested through those activities has become an equity-method affiliate of OLC.

Since OLI's initial investment in 2023, the Company and OLI have collaborated for approximately three years, strengthening their alignment on business and human resource matters while deepening mutual understanding and trust. This additional investment builds on that collaboration and further strengthens their partnership.

The Company operates businesses nationwide that support children's development through sports and education. Going forward, the Company plans to create enriching experiences and opportunities for children to grow, taking into account the Oriental Land Group's emphasis on "children's happiness."

The Company also believes that it is important for these initiatives not only to create social value but also to develop into sustainable, revenue-generating businesses. By leveraging the respective strengths of both companies, the Company aims to create both social and business value.

Furthermore, the Company views becoming an equity-method affiliate as an important milestone in enhancing its credibility and supporting medium- to long-term growth. Through its deeper relationship with the Oriental Land Group, the Company seeks to further strengthen its relationships of trust with a broad range of stakeholders, including local governments, schools, parents and business partners, reinforce its business foundation in sports and education, and enhance its corporate value over the medium to long term.

3. Nationwide Business Platform and Future Growth

The Company operates sports schools in all 47 prefectures of Japan, providing approximately 70,000 members with opportunities for personal growth through sports.

The Company also supports the transition of school extracurricular sports activities to community-based programs, drawing on its expertise in recruiting and training instructors, operational management and safety management.

As this transition progresses, the Company remains committed to creating environments in which children can continue participating in sports, with an emphasis on the quality and safety of instruction.

Building on this strengthened capital relationship, the Company will continue to pursue growth in its existing businesses and improve service quality, with the aim of enhancing its corporate value over the medium to long term.

4. Management Independence and Future Collaboration

The Company will continue to operate as an independent business entity while preserving its corporate philosophy and culture and deepening its partnership with OLI.

Building on the trust established through their collaboration to date, the two companies will continue to explore ways to deliver value that supports children's development and helps them realize their potential.

5. Outlook

At present, there are no additional matters to announce regarding specific future collaborative initiatives or their impact on the Company's financial performance.

Should any matters requiring disclosure arise, the Company will make appropriate disclosures in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.
